decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2.	Prior to the commencement of this development, the kiosks shown on the plans hereby approved to be removed, and which are currently located on the eastern side of Lampton Road shall have been removed in their entirety and the public highway made good to match the existing.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan 1:1250; Location Plan 1: 500; Block Plan; The KX Plus Benefits and Specification; Street Views Photographs Received: 29 March 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.
description: Installation of 2 telephone kiosks following the removal of kiosks from outside 55 Lampton Road
